verdict.rationale: Choosing data region or residency is a fair question for a SaaS experimentation platform, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents a region or residency selection option. Warehouse Native running analysis in the customer's own warehouse is an adjacent architecture choice, not a documented residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
